verdict.rationale: Render provides managed databases, in-memory storage, environment variables, and private networking that ease connecting to backing services, but this is standard PaaS provisioning plus env-var wiring—not true 'native bindings' that eliminate SDK/credential boilerplate for arbitrary external APIs. Missing for 10: evidence of auto-generated typed clients/bindings, zero-config credential injection for third-party APIs, and any binding mechanism beyond env vars and private networking.
